name: FileUploader

props.name: accept
props.description: Specify the types of files that this input should be able to receive

props.name: buttonLabel
props.description: Provide the label text to be read by screen readers when interacting with the `<FileUploaderButton>`

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether file input is disabled

props.name: filenameStatus
props.description: Specify the status of the File Upload

props.name: iconDescription
props.description: Provide a description for the complete/close icon that can be read by screen readers

props.name: labelDescription
props.description: Specify the description text of this `<FileUploader>`

props.name: labelTitle
props.description: Specify the title text of this `<FileUploader>`

props.name: maxFileSize
props.description: Maximum file size allowed in bytes. Files larger than this will be marked invalid

props.name: multiple
props.description: Specify if the component should accept multiple files to upload

props.name: name
props.description: Provide a name for the underlying `<input>` node

props.name: size
props.description: Specify the size of the FileUploaderButton, from a list of available sizes.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon FileUploader rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
